change.after: "lowest MTU of all external interfaces is used"

consequence.statement: Auto-detected MTU may now be lower than before, as the lowest MTU across all external interfaces is used rather than the primary interface's MTU.
consequence.remediation: Verify the detected MTU, or set it manually via the MTU helm option, --mtu agent flag or mtu in CNI configuration.

assertion.statement: Cilium MTU auto-detection now uses the lowest MTU of all external interfaces instead of only the primary interface (ENI secondary interfaces excluded); manual MTU configuration still works.
